entities.name: Gabrijel Veočić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gabrijel Veočić is a Croatian boxer. He competed at the 2024 European Amateur Boxing Championships, winning the gold medal in the light heavyweight event. He also competed at the 2024 Summer Olympics in the men's 80 kg event, but was defeated in the quarter-final by Christian Javier Pinales.
